phase_name: Inbound cross-reference, deploy, and full verification

objectives.description: Drift check: 'consolidate unless' matches standard only
objectives.note: Initial drift grep caught full reason-list restatement in task.md (Create Task Mode Step 2.5, Expand Mode Step 2) and errors.md (Step 3.5); condensed all three to a path pointer with no enumerated list. Re-ran grep: now matches multi-task-creation-standard.md only.

objectives.description: Pre-deploy foreign-modification check, gate deploy on it
objectives.note: git status --short agent-system/ shows foreign uncommitted modifications (orchestrate.md, command-gate-in.sh, orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, orchestrate-triage-classify.sh, their tests, core/typst index-entries.json) -- task 293's in-flight sibling work plus pre-existing unrelated dirt. Per plan's explicit contingency, deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh/check-deploy-freshness.sh are deferred to a later cycle rather than run against another writer's partial tree.

objectives.description: Deploy and verify byte-for-byte match, freshness, task-refs, wiring, docs
objectives.note: Deferred per objective 3's observation. check-task-references.sh (repo-wide, deploy-independent) run and PASS. validate-wiring.sh / check-extension-docs.sh not run since they report deployed-vs-source drift that is meaningless before redeploy and would be noisy against the sibling's in-flight tree.
